system.description:
• Effect: Once per day, while performing, all listeners must make a Will save or be held in rapture — unable to leave while the Bard performs, and remaining held for rounds equal to Bard's level after they stop.
  • Affects up to 20 Levels of targets — lowest Level first
  • Affects any humanoid regardless of language
  • Scales: 40 Levels at 16th, 80 Levels at 19th, 160 Levels at 22nd
